subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：Tosyl（p-toluenesulfonamide）？
A. Na, NH₃(l)
B. NaOMe, MeOH
C. DIBAL-H, CH₂Cl₂, −78 °C
D. BBr₃, CH₂Cl₂
explanation: A very robust sulfonamide; removing it needs dissolving metal or another strong reductant. Dissolving metal reduces the S–N bond.
